title: Winner Authority Resolution
summary: Current code defines three conflicting 'best' notions: rank/select_best (random_forest_shallow__stable_4__RANGE), report best_candidate (same), and acceptance-eligible winner (xgb_baseline_phase96__stable_except_unstable__RANGE). Deterministic production rule: Acceptance PASS + highest composite → exactly one winner.
production_rule:
ProductionWinner :=
  argmax(composite_score)
  WHERE evaluate_acceptance(candidate, baseline) == PASS
    AND probability_gate_passed == True
wiring_gaps: optimization_orchestrator still uses select_best not select_production_winner
report best_candidate field still reflects select_best
